newsitem.title: UK: Fine Art completes sale of Papertree chain.
newsitem.headline: Fine Art completes sale of Papertree chain.

text.p: Fine Art Developments Plc said on Thursday it had completed the sale of Papertree, the group's loss making retail chain.
The 5.9 million stg sale to CBC Investments Ltd, the parent company of The Greetings Store Group Ltd, was effected on Wednesday, the group said in a statement.
Fine Arts, the greetings card manufacturer, has entered a five year supply agreement for its products with CBC.
The Greetings Store Group comprises a chain of over 200 stores, making it the UK's third largest greeting cards and gift chain.
